facts.text: The resort is on the white sands of Nusa Dua Beach.
facts.excerpt: Find your balance on the white sands of Nusa Dua Beach.

facts.text: The resort has a private section of Nusa Dua beach.
facts.excerpt: Boasting a private section of the stunning Nusa Dua beach

facts.text: The resort is next to the Bali International Convention Centre.
facts.excerpt: Located next to the Bali International Convention Centre

facts.text: Beachfront cabanas directly in front of the resort have uninterrupted sea views.
facts.excerpt: our beachfront cabanas offer a serene retreat where gentle ocean breezes, soft sands, and uninterrupted sea views

facts.text: Terrace rooms have a private outdoor area with lounge chairs and direct access to the lagoon-style pools.
facts.excerpt: choose a terrace room with a private outdoor area, lounge chairs and direct access to our lagoon-style swimming pools

facts.text: Each Ocean View Suite is named for one of six Balinese regions and has its own design.
facts.excerpt: each suite is named for one of six Balinese regions (Karangasem, Bangli, Klungkung, Panglipuran, Celuk and Tenganan) and reflects its own unique design

facts.text: Rooms have marble vanities and deep soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a spa-like escape in your own room with marble vanities, deep soaking tubs

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa has his and hers thermal facilities and a Shiatsu room.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in our luxurious his and hers thermal facilities, release muscle tension in the Shiatsu room or rejuvenate with sacred spa rituals.

facts.text: The spa uses local ingredients such as seaweed and clay.
facts.excerpt: the spa sources local ingredients such as seaweed and clay

facts.text: Wellness Ambassador Dr. Jitendra Pokhriyal leads the resort's wellness programs.
facts.excerpt: Hailing from the serene Himalayas, our Wellness Ambassador, Dr. Jitendra Pokhriyal spearheads resort's wellness programs

facts.text: The wellness programs include Reiki, daily yoga, meditation and pranayama breathing.
facts.excerpt: His offerings include stress management, Reiki healing, food and nutrition consultations, daily yoga sessions, meditation, and Pranayama (breathing techniques).

facts.text: Children have the Westin Family Kids Club and a waterslide.
facts.excerpt: Little ones can make friends at Westin Family Kids Club or take on the 12-meter waterslide

facts.text: Guests can join a Balinese dance lesson, watch fruit carving or visit the hotel temple.
facts.excerpt: Join a Balinese dance lesson, watch a fruit carving demonstration or visit the hotel temple to experience the island’s culture up close.

facts.text: The resort has two lighted tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: play a match on one of our two lighted

facts.text: The resort's beachfront restaurant serves casual fresh seafood by the beach.
facts.excerpt: Nusa Dua's beloved beachfront dining experience is back with a new concept. Casual, delicious and always fresh. Savor seafood at its best by the beach in Bali.

facts.text: Wellness options include yoga, reformer pilates, an ice bath and beach workouts.
facts.excerpt: Find your balance with yoga, reformer pilates, ice bath, gym and beach workouts in Nusa Dua, Bali.
